finance.title: Personal Finance Tracker
finance.description: A personal finance management platform designed to help users organize their income, expenses, accounts, budgets, and financial activity through a modern web and mobile experience. The idea originated from my father's manual Excel-based bookkeeping and the opportunity to make financial tracking more accessible.
finance.visionNote: The platform is in active development. The items below describe the product direction. They are not presented as finished features, because the implementation status of each one is not verified on this site.
features: Transaction detection from device notifications, confirmed by the user before saving
finance.contribution: I am building the web and mobile experience around a shared backend, with authentication, a relational model for financial records, and delivery in stages.
challenges: One backend shared by web and mobile

soulspace.title: SoulSpace
soulspace.description: SoulSpace is an AI-powered mental health support companion I developed as a graduation project with one teammate. It explored how conversational AI could offer supportive interactions for people who may hesitate to seek professional help. The system was designed to encourage professional support when that was appropriate.
soulspace.disclaimer: This was an academic project. It is not clinically validated, medically certified, or a proven therapeutic tool.
soulspace.contribution: I worked on full-stack development, conversational AI integration, model training and testing, application functionality, and collaboration with my teammate.
challenges: Fitting a conversational system into Laravel
Encouraging professional care without replacing it
Building the project as a two-person team
milestones: Received an A grade at university
Pitched to angel investors in South Africa

messages.text: That sounds heavy. I'm here to listen. If this feels like more than you want to carry alone, a mental health professional can help.
I'm not sure where to start.
A counselor or your local health service can be a solid next step. I can help you think through what you want to say.

teknofest.title: TeknoFest PPG Signal Analyzer
teknofest.description: A Flutter application that captures photoplethysmography (PPG) pulse signals with a smartphone camera, processes that data, and presents the results as graphs and numerical readings.
teknofest.contribution: I developed the Flutter frontend, integrated the app with a Python backend, and implemented the visualization of the signal results. In our five-person team I coordinated meetings, presented progress, and helped distribute tasks.
challenges: Connecting Flutter to a Python backend
teknofest.result: The project was entered in the TeknoFest competition.
teknofest.resultNote: This page does not claim a placement or award.

client.title: Client Website Development
client.body: At Dev Secure I developed and maintained Laravel websites for clients including restaurants, cafés, clinics, and personal sites. The work included AI-integrated functionality, hosting troubleshooting, and database maintenance. One example was integrating an AI-related calorie calculation feature into a restaurant website.

blog.title: Laravel Blog Platform
blog.body: During my internship at Macellan Inc. I built a Laravel blog with APIs and newsletter functionality. I also worked with unit tests, feature tests, Blade, Vue, Artisan, Docker, and Agile team practices.

about.title: Beyond the Code
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer based in Istanbul, Türkiye. I graduated from İstinye University in 2025 with a degree in Software Engineering.

I've worked across backend development, full-stack web applications, mobile development, AI-integrated systems, and technical team coordination. I like turning a real problem into software people can actually use.
I'm looking for technically challenging projects, experienced teams, and room to keep learning. I'm especially interested in financial technology, health-related technology, and entrepreneurship.
